spec_match.rationale: Runs Array.from(it).join vs it.join on identical input and verifies identical output.

interactive.rationale: Size select + "Run the comparison" produced medians, peak-intermediate and output-length readouts.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Delivers the "array you were building anyway" angle and honestly says time is not the argument.

edge_cases.rationale: Honest about timing noise and lack of per-op heap data; the 1,000,000 option blocks the main thread with no progress/yield.

references.rationale: Cites chromestatus.com/feature/<id> in the see-also block plus the spec/explainer.

conformance.rationale: Feature suite 7/7 PASS and checks the method, arity and Array.prototype.join-equivalent separator semantics rather than bare existence.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Playwright headless Chromium 153.0.8010.12 against a local server on :3109 (chrome-devtools-mcp not available to this pass): 200,000-value run: both routes 1,288,889 chars, native join slower by ~4ms, console clean; not a chrome-devtools-mcp/Canary pass, and no accessibility-tree inspection.

telemetry_health.rationale: showcaseTelemetry is loaded and the page records named assertions for its main measurement; no unexpected errors seen.

design_system.rationale: Inline styles use the design-system variables; button overrides keep text/background pairs readable; not a static card.

accessibility.rationale: Native, labelled controls (no unnamed controls found), visible focus on a Tab walk, and results surfaced as text in status/output regions.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: At 360×740 documentElement.scrollWidth === innerWidth (wide content scrolls inside its own container) and desktop 1280×800 lays out cleanly.

openQuestions.title: Keep the page responsive during the 1,000,000-value run
openQuestions.detail: The largest size runs synchronously; show a busy state and yield between repetitions (scheduler.yield / setTimeout) so INP is not hurt and the status region can announce progress.
